plugins.description: Thirteen Claude skills for meme coin trading: a coin scanner sorted by edge, a launch radar for new pump.fun coins and graduations, a rug-check analyst (RugCheck and GoPlus, Solana, Base and BSC), a news monitor with public Telegram channels, an entry timer, an exit planner that counts the fees of your app, a time machine that replays 10,000 next hours and backtests many coins, a risk manager with a test phase, a budget manager in euros, an order executor that never touches a wallet, price and rug alerts, a whale and dev wallet tracker, and a trade journal.
